subject: ShellPkg/Ls: Remove unused TimeZone parameter
reasons: Parameter removal refactor: removes the TimeZone parameter from PrintLsOutput() signature and all its call sites (2 calls), plus removes the associated gRT->GetTime() setup code in the caller

Coccinelle can handle parameter removal from function signatures and call sites, but this also involves removing associated dead code (the gRT->GetTime call and TheTime variable) which requires more context-sensitivity
Low repetitiveness: affects only one function's signature and two call sites in a single file; the cleanup involves removing several distinct code fragments, not a uniform structural pattern
